messages.content: Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: I love this product!

Classification: Positive
Reason: The text expresses strong positive sentiment with the word "love" and an exclamation mark.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: This is the worst experience ever.

Classification: Negative
Reason: The text uses superlative negative language ("worst", "ever") indicating strong dissatisfaction.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: The package arrived on time.

Classification: Neutral
Reason: This is a factual statement without emotional content or clear sentiment indicators.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Amazing quality and fast shipping!

Classification: Positive
Reason: Contains positive descriptors ("amazing", "fast") and an enthusiastic tone.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Terrible customer service and broken product.

Classification: Negative
Reason: Multiple negative indicators ("terrible", "broken") describing poor experience.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: The item is blue.

Classification: Neutral
Reason: Purely descriptive statement with no sentiment or opinion expressed.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Exceeded my expectations in every way!

Classification: Positive
Reason: Strong positive sentiment with "exceeded expectations" and enthusiastic punctuation.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Don't waste your money on this.

Classification: Negative
Reason: Direct negative recommendation with warning language ("don't waste").
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Delivered yesterday.

Classification: Neutral
Reason: Simple factual statement about delivery timing without sentiment.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Highly recommend to everyone!

Classification: Positive
Reason: Explicit positive recommendation with enthusiastic language ("highly").
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Disappointed with the quality.

Classification: Negative
Reason: Expresses disappointment, a clear negative emotional response.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Product weighs 2 pounds.

Classification: Neutral
Reason: Objective factual information without opinion or sentiment.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Absolutely fantastic purchase!

Classification: Positive
Reason: Strong positive sentiment with intensifiers ("absolutely", "fantastic") and exclamation.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Cheap materials, fell apart quickly.

Classification: Negative
Reason: Multiple negative quality indicators ("cheap", "fell apart") describing product failure.
Classify this text as positive, negative, or neutral: Comes in three colors.

Classification: Neutral
Reason: Descriptive product information without evaluative language.
